split: train_candidate only, hash(family_id) modulo 4: 0 for paired logistic fit, 1..3 for reference statistics; dev_reserve previously seen for SP02, one poem per family/form; no test_reserve decoding
language: one deterministic nonterminal transposition of distinct characters with identical resolved P/Z per eligible line; document failures/skips and all train-attested-new-bigram hard subset; exact reconstruction conditional on one known swap, compare uniform candidate choice
discourse: swap entire second and fourth couplets of same poem; hold all eight lines intact, score with all final characters removed. Hard transfer: exchange closing couplets between distinct families same length and exact final char; each family at most once per form; symmetric original-v-crossed score, pure position preference cancels
model: pairwise logistic on generic count-derived features, no intercept, reference/fit disjoint; fixed L2=.05; line position-only and bigram-only controls; discourse position-only and boundary-only controls
resampling: paired family macro, 2000 deterministic bootstrap draws; crossed endings use independent family pairs within each form; ties half; report 5/7 separately
gates: both forms: syntax primary lower95>.55 and gain over position-only lower95>0 and attested-bigram subset >=50 families and lower95>.50; discourse primary gain over position-only lower95>0 and crossed endings >=100 pairs per form and lower95>.50. No production promotion without independent literary assessment.
transfer: frozen SP02 outputs only: same initial poem and 4 untouched refinement outputs, deduplicate by exact text; rank by mean component ranks (local/discourse equally weighted), tie by SHA256; blind review versus best old objective on same candidates; no human ratings supplied
notes: Task protocol written before development scores were inspected. This is local protocol locking, not independent external preregistration. No repeated dev tuning. Raw source order is not a grammatical or literary gold label.
